channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Jameson Williams Reveals Offseason Focus After Career Year
item.description: Detroit Lions wide receiver Jameson Williams explains why adding strength is his top offseason goal after a breakout 2025 season and how it could elevate the offense in 2026.

item.title: Eagles Request Interview With Former Detroit Lions OC
item.description: Former Detroit Lions offensive coordinator Jim Bob Cooter is drawing interest from the Philadelphia Eagles for their OC vacancy after a strong season with the Indianapolis Colts.

item.title: NFL Insider Reveals How Mike McDaniel Feels About Detroit Lions OC Position
item.description: NFL insider Jeff Darlington reveals how Mike McDaniel feels about the Detroit Lions’ offensive coordinator opening as the coaching carousel nears its end.

item.title: Denver Broncos Get Devastating News Regarding Bo Nix
item.description: The Denver Broncos advanced to the AFC Championship Game with an overtime win over the Bills, but lost QB Bo Nix to a season-ending ankle injury, according to Adam Schefter.

item.title: Here’s How Much Money the Lions Would Save If Taylor Decker Retires
item.description: Taylor Decker’s potential retirement could free up $11,604,000 in salary cap space for the Detroit Lions as he evaluates his shoulder injury and future in 2026.

item.title: Report: Detroit Lions DC Kelvin Sheppard to Interview With AFC Team
item.description: The Miami Dolphins will interview Detroit Lions defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard in person Monday, per ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler, as his rapid coaching rise continues.

item.title: Mickey Redmond to Call Final Game With Detroit Red Wings Prior to Medical Procedure
item.description: Detroit Red Wings legend and broadcaster Mickey Redmond will call his final game before undergoing cervical spine surgery, stepping away temporarily from the booth to focus on recovery.

item.title: Charlie Batch Goes Viral For ‘Catching Stray’ After Texans’ Loss
item.description: Former Detroit Lions quarterback Charlie Batch went viral after a fan compared C.J. Stroud’s rough playoff performance to him, prompting a hilarious response from the retired QB.

item.title: OC Candidate Named Perfect Fit For Detroit Lions
item.description: The Detroit Lions have been matched with Ravens QB coach Tee Martin as an ideal offensive coordinator candidate.

item.title: NFL Championship Sunday Schedule: Times, Channels, and Matchups Revealed
item.description: The NFL’s final four are set for Championship Sunday as the Patriots face the Broncos in the AFC title game and the Rams travel to Seattle to take on the Seahawks for the NFC crown.
